thread:
elaine: Heads-up — I opened a compact migration quickstart PR for v1->v2 (PR 4931). Need a focused pass on SDK code samples, embed dimension note, and a short alias-fallback example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4931 :eyes:

sam: I can handle SDK snippets. Found a TS snippet still using old param names. Will push a branch with fixes.

lina: Note: rwd-embed -> rwd-embed-v2 changes embedding dimension from 1536 -> 2048. Add a small compatibility subsection and sample conversion code (padding/truncation guidance).

matt: Reworked the JS/TS snippet for responses.create. Example I plan to land: ```ts
const r = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rwd/text-embedding-1',
  input: 'hello from redwood'
})
// r.output[0].embedding -> Float32Array(2048)
```

noah: Two asks from support: 1) alias fallback JSON for teams wanting to preserve old alias routing, 2) callout that Dedicated has slightly higher per-minute rate-limits but lower burst cap.

elaine: For alias fallback add example mapping and recommended rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Keep guide concise so customers can migrate quickly.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR 4931 (docs). Running lint, linkcheck, snippet smoke-tests.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: broken link found -> https://old-links.redwood.ai/sdk/v1/snippets needs redirect to /sdk/migration.

sam: I'll add the redirect and update TS snippet in the same PR. Also adding a short changelog entry under "Docs: v1->v2 migration - compact quickstart".

matt: Noted lint rule: JSON examples must use double quotes. I'll align examples before pushing.

elaine: Plan: owner = @sam. Deadline EOD. If CI green, I'll merge. Tag me if anything blocks. Thanks! :tada:
